acceptanceResults.criterion: IAQ-003 and IAQ-010 expose only their exact accepted GET browser and owner paths, page limit, stable ordering, deep links, metadata field groups and action allowlists.
evidence: CertificateController exposes only GET /v1/hris/workbench/self-service/requests, GET /v1/hris/workbench/operations/certificates/documents and the separately sealed POST command.

CertificateQueryDefinition pins IAQ-003 and IAQ-010 to their exact browser and owner paths, limit 100, itemPublicId stable tie-break, canonical deep links, field groups, filters, sorts and action allowlists.
The frontend adapter and strict projection parser map only the two accepted browser paths and reject unknown query identities, additive fields and cross-query actions.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Both projections enforce COMPLETE, EMPTY, PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE cardinality, freshness, typed partial failure, cursor scope/revision and VIEW, MASK or OMIT field-decision invariants.
evidence: Backend contract tests cover state cardinality, typed partial failure, field-decision summaries and cursor binding to the sealed tenant, query, population, revisions, as-of, requested sort, limit and last item.
CertificateProjector prevents MASKed metadata from influencing returned items, filtering or ordering and counts absent sealed groups as OMIT.

Frontend parsing revalidates all projection states and field decisions at the component consumption boundary; only retryable 429, 503 or network refresh failures retain stale metadata with the command synchronously fenced.

acceptanceResults.criterion: PEP-HRM-012 accepts only the five sealed request fields and required command headers, rejects unknown fields and returns the durable 202 CommandReceiptV1 contract.
evidence: The command JSON boundary accepts exactly personPublicId, certificateType, purposeCode, locale and asOf and rejects unknown, missing, duplicate and wrong-typed members.
Authorization, Idempotency-Key, If-Match and X-Correlation-ID are required; X-Purpose-Code is the only sealed optional header.
The owner returns 202 CommandReceiptV1, and the frontend validates correlation, purpose, command type, originating action and subject bindings before accepting the receipt.

acceptanceResults.criterion: The owner deterministically chooses self or operations authority from trusted actor-person identity and personPublicId, enforces the exact duty, purpose, population and field groups and requires common HIGH step-up before mutation; TEAM_MANAGEMENT is negatively asserted as DENY/DEFER with no team profile and no fallback.
evidence: Subject equality with the trusted actor selects only the self profile; a non-self subject selects only the operations profile and the caller cannot supply an authorization mode.
Exact route, profile, binding, projection, schema, field-policy, capability, duty, purpose, population, predicate and target-binding tuples fail closed on any mismatch.
Both profiles require the one shared HIGH-risk action route before mutation, while TEAM_MANAGEMENT is denied before population resolution with no profile or fallback.

acceptanceResults.criterion: The tenant, command type and idempotency-key scope serializes concurrent reservation; same-hash replay returns the original receipt and different-hash reuse returns 409 without another side effect.
evidence: The V58 unique index seals tenant_id, command_type and idempotency_key after a duplicate preflight that does not delete, merge or rewrite receipts.

Same-hash replay returns every original durable receipt state, including success and non-success, without rerunning the artifact port; a different hash or command schema version returns 409 before side effects.
Recovery tests cover a winning concurrent reservation and a receipt committed while the caller waits for the subject lock; both replay before challenge consumption or artifact invocation.

acceptanceResults.criterion: People V58 creates exactly the two certificate metadata tables, blueprint constraints, queue and receipt indexes, forced tenant RLS policies and immutable transition guards with no second migration or historical edit.
evidence: The exact leased V58 path creates ppl_certificate_requests and ppl_issued_certificates, one queue index and one stricter receipt index, two FORCE RLS policies and two locked-down guard functions/triggers.
Static migration tests prove the closed manifest and unchanged V54 receipt migration; the historical V1 through V57 blob/path manifest is byte-identical at base and result.

Real PostgreSQL 16.15 Testcontainers tests cover clean migration, V57-to-V58 upgrade, duplicate preflight, strict receipt uniqueness, RLS, state guards, immutable fields and rollback with zero skipped tests in the executed targets.

acceptanceResults.criterion: A successful issue freezes template, seal and subject inputs plus object identity and digest, then atomically commits request ISSUED, issued metadata, receipt, audit and the exact six-field CertificateIssued.v1 outbox event.
evidence: CertificateService freezes subject, template and seal inputs before artifact invocation and persists the returned object identity, object version and digest as immutable issued metadata.
The successful transaction commits the ISSUED request, issued row, succeeded receipt, audit event and semantic outbox together.
The CertificateIssued.v1 payload is exactly requestPublicId, certificatePublicId, subjectPersonPublicId, certificateType, issuedAt and expiresAt.

acceptanceResults.criterion: The production artifact adapter fails closed with no issued state or event while the test-only conformance double proves deterministic success, retryable failure and rollback without becoming a production binding.
evidence: FailClosedCertificateArtifactAdapter is the only production binding and never returns artifact success or performs network, filesystem, object, template, seal, signature or document-content work.
CertificateArtifactConformanceDouble exists only under the test source set and proves deterministic immutable metadata plus retryable unavailability.
A real PostgreSQL service transaction with the failing conformance double rolls back request, issued metadata, receipt success, audit and outbox effects.

acceptanceResults.criterion: No API, event, projection or UI reveals document bytes, object or download URL, verification token or hash, revoke control, download action, revoke action or invented capability.
evidence: The projection and event closed sets are metadata-only, and the frontend strict parser rejects additive disclosure fields.

Central admission, production artifact binding, download, revoke, expiry acceptance, access/download audit acceptance, browser gate, merge, Platform cutover, tenant enrollment and activation remain pending with zero Stage-A source and full-slice business completion credit.

nonblockingResiduals: The owner-side DATA binding, projection, schema and field-policy keys require central product-authorization v52 adoption and proof before admission.
Backend Idempotency-Key length uses Java UTF-16 code units, which differs from JSON Schema Unicode code-point length for non-BMP input.
Frontend and backend certificateType validation trim or reject edge whitespace more narrowly than the accepted generic string schema.
Local Authorization Bearer and numeric version If-Match handling are narrower than the accepted transport patterns.
The local Problem code enum is broader than the Stage-A cases exercised by the bounded tests.
The concurrency suite models the winning receipt race deterministically but does not execute two simultaneous database insertion sessions.
